title: GTA 5 - Trevor's Safehouse | Showcases in Description
author: Aequotis

title.es: Refugio de Trevor en el desierto

generated.description: A GTA 5 inspired motor home and safehouse built from sand, quartz, and iron bars, with a flat trailer-like body, stepped roof edges, and a long platform running across the top. It sits on a sand and grass base with acacia and jungle leaves, carpets, and sunflowers around it. Roughly 44 by 17 by 27 blocks with about 2,660 blocks; the interior has furnaces, hoppers, a cauldron, flower pots, and signs.
